Owner: ScalaFIM dataset JVM IO. Reproduced through NiftiResponseBlockSource.open(path, Some(cache)) during selective-estimation qualification bd-01M1ZAMKEPXXHF8342H0K70NSH. Existing integrity/quota implementation issues bd-01M1VMP1X2FT277F64EYGK46N7 and bd-01M1VPB97MT4CKDKDR1GRD6A08 are closed; preserve their guarantees.

A167772512-byte float64 fixture takes9.085/9.163seconds for verified staging misses in the two condition/FIR cases. The compressed source is approximately161MB. Source inspection finds default GZIPInputStream compressed buffer512 despite an outer64KiB buffer. An independent JDK22 read-count probe of the exact condition gzip gives315053reads, max751 decoded bytes/read, versus4923reads with64KiB compressed buffer. Each native staging read triggers quota, cancellation and getFileStore/getUsableSpace checks. The probe with that space check takes7.37-7.39seconds with512bytes versus0.889-0.901seconds with64KiB; decoded SHA256 is identical. This probe isolates a mechanism; native timing remains the admission authority.

Scope: explicitly size the gzip decoder buffer to the existing bounded64KiB copy size. Preserve compressed and expanded digest verification, trailing compressed bytes, source-change checks, aggregate/expanded/free-space limits before writes, atomic publication, lock behavior, interruption and partial-file cleanup. No cache trust shortcut or broad IO rewrite.

Acceptance: native dataset JVM tests including integrity/quota/concurrency/cancellation, compile/shared-platform checks as applicable, exact-byte public staging miss/reuse against the archived reference fixture, frozen-classpath proof that changed source was loaded, and relevant first-level/app consumer checks. Retain before/after timings, iteration-count evidence and source hashes. Provider-native source and application candidate changes remain local; no publication authorized.
set.title: Avoid tiny gzip reads in verified NIfTI staging
